en.title: US Lawmakers Push Bill to Expand Accessible Affordable Housing for Disabled
en.summary: A proposed bill aims to increase the number of Low-Income Housing Tax Credit projects that include accessible units for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, a teenager with severe gastrointestinal disability faces possible NDIS funding cuts that could threaten his life, and state digital accessibility officers report progress but ongoing challenges. Additional highlights include Louisiana's tourism accessibility campaign, a barrier‑free tour with sign language interpreters in Chungli, and a guide to elderly‑friendly marine museums in Taiwan.

zh-TW.title: 美國推擴無障礙親民住宅法案
zh-TW.summary: 美國提出法案，旨在提升低收入住房稅抵項目中無障礙單位的數量，以惠殘障人士。同時，澳洲一名依賴管道進食的十六歲少年面臨NDIS資金可能大幅削減，生存受威脅。此外，州級數位無障礙官員報告進展但仍有挑戰，路易斯安那州推出觀光無障礙改善計畫，並有討論殘障與問責的社群討論。
